title: Provable Non-Acceleration of Standard Strang Splittings of Kinetic Langevin Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2608.25279v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The OBABO and BAOAB schemes and the other standard Strang splittings of kinetic (underdamped) Langevin dynamics are widely used Markov chain Monte Carlo algorithms. Under a suitable friction scaling, the underlying diffusion relaxes on a ballistic time scale, suggesting that these discretizations, suitably tuned, sample targets with condition number $\kappa$ in $O(\sqrt{\kappa})$ iterations. We prove that no fixed choice of step size and friction, based only on the curvature bounds and the dimension, achieves this acceleration: total variation mixing time lower bounds for OBABO show that ballistic cold-start mixing fails uniformly over the smooth strongly convex class, and the lower bounds extend, with the same orders, to BAOAB and the other four Strang splittings. The proof transfers non-acceleration from optimization to sampling. Eliminating velocity gives an exact noisy heavy-ball recursion, and by the non-acceleration theorem of Go

translated_title: 标准Strang分裂动力学Langevin动力学的不可加速性证明
translated_abstract: OBABO和BAOAB格式以及其他标准的动力学（欠阻尼）Langevin动力学的Strang分裂是广泛使用的马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛算法。在适当的摩擦缩放条件下，底层扩散在弹道时间尺度上松弛，这表明这些离散化方法在适当调整后，能够在$O(\sqrt{\kappa})$次迭代中采样条件数为$\kappa$的目标分布。我们证明，仅基于曲率界和维度，任何固定的步长和摩擦选择都无法实现这种加速：OBABO的总变差混合时间下界表明，弹道冷启动混合在光滑强凸类上均匀失败，且这些下界以相同的阶数扩展到BAOAB和其他四种Strang分裂。证明将优化中的不可加速性转移到采样中。消除速度后得到精确的噪声重球递归，并通过Go等人的不可加速定理得出结论。
tldr: 本文证明标准Strang分裂（如OBABO和BAOAB）在动力学Langevin动力学中无法实现$O(\sqrt{\kappa})$的加速混合，即使调整步长和摩擦参数，其混合时间下界表明冷启动在光滑强凸类上均匀失败。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that standard Strang splittings (e.g., OBABO and BAOAB) cannot achieve $O(\sqrt{\kappa})$ accelerated mixing for kinetic Langevin dynamics, as mixing time lower bounds show cold-start fails uniformly over the smooth strongly convex class, regardless of step size and friction choices.
